notes: Single reusable CLI (vocabulary builder with frequency filtering) plus its output artifact on the visible corpora. Hard elements: Unicode-aware lowercased \w+ tokenization, multi-file count aggregation, protected-term override including count-0 and count-1 terms, mixed-case protected lists, threshold boundary semantics, punctuation/blank-line noise, exact sorted deduplicated output. Generalization is genuinely probed: the verifier re-executes the builder on three hidden (corpus, protected-list, threshold) triples with distinct inputs.
